# phase-059 — Make REPL errors point at the code: source context through the color system

## You must change `src/`

This phase declares `must_touch: [src/]`. The gate fails the phase unless at
least one changed file falls under it. Writing tests, documentation or a report
is not enough — if you finish without touching that area, the phase fails on
exactly that check.


## Evidence — verified finding

```
REPL errors discard the rendering the language already owns: `execute_code` at src/repl/mod.rs:407 prints `Error: {}` via `Display`, while `Error::render()` at src/error.rs:105 builds the full diagnostic — label, message, `--> location`, source line, and caret gutter (error.rs:105-125). Every REPL failure therefore shows less than `rb run` shows for the same program: no source line, no caret, no span, no color. inscript prints the offending line plus caret in-REPL for exactly this reason; a REPL that hides locations teaches users to leave it when something breaks.
```

**Re-verify this before you change anything.** If the finding no longer
reproduces on `main`, stop and write that to `FINDINGS.md` — a stale phase must
never be "fixed" by inventing a change.

## Goal

Route REPL error output through `Error::render()` with the session's current buffer as the source, colored through the phase-053 system (label + location in the error color, source line plain, caret line highlighted). The message text stays identical — color wraps it, never rewrites it.

## Method

1. Read `AGENTS.md` in full. Obey every hard rule; they are not negotiable.
2. Reproduce the finding. Record the exact command and the exact wrong output.
3. Write the failing test FIRST. Watch it fail. Do not touch production code
   until you have a red test that fails for the right reason.
4. Make the smallest change that turns it green.
5. Run the four gates yourself before claiming anything:

   ```bash
   cargo fmt --all -- --check
   cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
   cargo test --all-targets
   ./rbops/verify.sh phase-059
   ```

6. Write `REPORT.md` in the exact shape required by `AGENTS.md` section 4.

## Definition of done

- [ ] typing `say nosuchvar` prints the source line `say nosuchvar` plus a caret line under `nosuchvar` — asserted on the rendered string with colors stripped, so the test is immune to palette changes
- [ ] the same error through `rb run` and through the REPL carries the same `--> line:column` location (one test runs both and diffs the location line)
- [ ] with colors forced off the REPL error is byte-identical to `Error::render()` output for the same input (no REPL-specific reformatting hiding behind the colors)
- [ ] both engines agree: an error raised under the bytecode VM path renders with the same location as under the tree-walker (the session executes through one engine; the test runs the other and compares locations)
- [ ] edge_* tests cover a multiline-block error (caret points into the right buffered line, not line 1), an error with no span (renders message-only, never panics on a missing location), and a 500-character line (caret alignment survives wide content)
